translations.1: At dawn, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet cleared.
translations.10: Zeng Shijie, Elder Qin wants you at the ward. Senior Brother Moqi and I are here.
translations.11: Okay. The moment Miss Qiu wakes, come get me.
translations.12: Moqi Jing scratched his head and ran back down toward the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xie Xuan stood in the doorway. The sword was still sheathed, yet the lamps dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, I trust you are well. By my master's order, I have come for three-tenths of the qi stones.
translations.15: Three-tenths? Those qi stones were saved through the sect's hard work. Since when do outsiders come to take them?
translations.16: The ward is already cracked, and the qi stones aren't safe in your hands. I'll be back in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan gave a cold laugh and strode off without looking back.
translations.18: Three days means three days. She never goes back on her word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Qiu Shuang, asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me guard the ward. Yue Chuan is looking after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the array-eye token. Hold it, and you hold your Dao.
translations.23: Yue Chuan stuffed a medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms and murmured a few more reminders.
translations.24: At the gate, Moqi Jing handed over a rain cape.
translations.25: Thanks, Senior Brother Moqi. When Miss Qiu wakes, thank her for me.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the array-eye token safely away.
translations.27: Inside the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Good, you're awake. You were out for a whole day, so don't move around.
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled upright and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: Three bags, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The ward cracked again last night. Elder Qin hasn't slept all night.
translations.5: Before the words had faded, Moqi Jing came running up from below.
translations.6: Panting, he said a young woman lay collapsed by the road at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Bring her up at once. Ruoshui, fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: Moqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the hall at a run. The iron tag at her waist read: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: She isn't badly hurt, just drained of spiritual energy. One restoring pill will do.
